description: This tilted bar chart illustrates the Accuracy (%) of different models evaluated on two distinct metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, which are model names labeled from left to right as "...-Instruct" (partially obscured), "Audio-Reasoner", and "Qwen-2.5-Omni". The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy (%)", featuring a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 10 to 70 at regular intervals of 10 units. The chart utilizes grouped bars, with each category containing two side-by-side bars. According to the legend in the upper left, the blue bars represent "MMAU" and the purple bars represent "MMAR", positioned on the left and right within each group, respectively. For the "...-Instruct" category, the blue MMAU bar reaches approximately 55%, while the purple MMAR bar is the shortest on the chart at approximately 40%. For "Audio-Reasoner", the blue MMAU bar is near 75%, and the purple MMAR bar is near 60%. For "Qwen-2.5-Omni", both bars are the tallest in their respective series, extending beyond the highest labeled y-axis tick of 70. The groups are arranged in ascending order based on their overall height from left to right, and there are no specific visual emphases such as outlines or annotations applied to individual bars.
